messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — we need clear owners for the v2 compatibility + deprecation rollout next month. Two parallel tracks: 1) SDK releases (npm/py) + release notes, 2) API compatibility checks + canary runs. Who can take SDKs, who can take migration docs/canary ops? cc @ben @carol
ben: I can own SDK releases. PRs mostly green, but one breaking change in streaming client needs a minor API shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4523 — needs a couple of reviews. I can coordinate publishes.
carol: I’ll take migration docs + the compatibility matrix. Already started a draft in the docs repo. One blocker: platform-service drops a header in v2 that breaks our internal routing tests — filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4601. Need infra/owners to weigh in.
dave: QA can run the canary and smoke tests. Proposed canary window: 2 weeks of rolling canary at 5% then 25% then full. I can kick off the first canary week starting 2026-05-04 if infra approves. For smoke: `make smoke-e2e CANARY=true`.
erin: I ran the v2-mapper suite against dedicated and saw failures in KV cache reconciliation. Error snippet: ```ERROR: kv_cache: mismatch at seq=1024
Stack: .../kv_cache.cc:87``` I suspect a serialization edge in the runtime; filing an issue and assigning to eng-runtime.
ben: tagging reviewers @alice @erin for the streaming shim. Also, need CI permissions for the py-publish job — @deploy-bot shows failures on auth.
alice: Thanks. Tentative owners: SDK => ben, Docs/compat => carol, Canary ops => dave. I'll schedule an async rollout plan doc and share a timeline. action items: ben publish checklist, carol compat matrix by EOD next Tue, dave canary schedule by end of week.
ben: FYI, release checklist snippet: ```- bump major in py sdk
- add runtime shim for streaming
- run integration tests against canary endpoint
- publish to pypi/npm```
carol: Compat matrix note: we need model-variant mapping; ask research whether some models are pinned to v1-only for now. @alice can you ping research?
alice: will ping research and infra. Also adding an SLO: if canary error rate > 1% for 2 consecutive hours, auto-roll back to v1. Config I plan to use in console: `canary.percentages=[5,25,100]`, `rollback.error_rate=0.01`, `monitoring.window=2h`.
dave: ack. QA will watch the 2h rolling window and escalate.
erin: created issue ENG-RUNTIME-912 and linked failing stack traces. tagging runtime-owners in the issue.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job created job-20260504-001 for service=api-gateway, variants=[v1,v2], initial_percent=5 — scheduled 2026-05-04T08:00Z.
ben: I'll open the SDK release PRs this afternoon and add the migration note. ping @carol for docs cross-link.
carol: thanks — will add a compatibility table and migration checklist with code samples.
alice: great progress. I'll post the rollout timeline in #eng-releases and create a calendar invite for the handoff sync. If anything blocks your items, call it out here so I can unblock. :thumbsup:
